sections.heading: Grasshopper buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
cloud phone; call routing; call recording; sms messaging. True Solo · up to 1 seat · cloud phone | Solo Plus | Small Business. Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number; SMBs that want flat account pricing instead of per-seat UCaaS maths; Buyers replacing a personal mobile with a branded business line. Grasshopper is a long-standing SMB virtual phone system for US/Canada: pick a local or toll-free number, route to extensions, and take calls on mobile/desktop apps. Plans are flat. That catalogue mix is the Grasshopper setup filter — not a generic business-communications lecture.

Buyer question: does True Solo gating call routing (True Solo, Solo Plus, Small Business) change the Grasshopper decision before seats scale?

Decision thesis: unlike a generic business-communications shortlist, Grasshopper is worth it if Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number outweighs Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) — trade-off accepted before seats scale.

Best for: Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number; SMBs that want flat account pricing instead of per-seat UCaaS maths; Buyers replacing a personal mobile with a branded business line (Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number).

Poor fit when: Teams needing full UCaaS (meetings + team chat + deep IVR + CTI); Sales orgs that need a power dialer or CRM-first phone; Multi-country or contact-centre deployments. Avoid if Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) would block go-live.

sections.heading: Grasshopper limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above; True Solo is capped at one user and one extension because it forces process changes or add-ons around Grasshopper when cloud phone is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on True Solo with exit criteria before annual seats. Capacity note: True Solo: up to 1 seat.

Plan trade-off: you gain call routing (True Solo, Solo Plus, Small Business) at the expense of Entry price and seat minimums vs routing, CTI and analytics depth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: True Solo · up to 1 seat · cloud phone | Solo Plus | Small Business.

Alternative context: unlike OpenPhone, Grasshopper is preferable when Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number because cloud phone plus call routing (True Solo, Solo Plus, Small Business) match; prefer OpenPhone when Teams needing full UCaaS (meetings + team chat + deep IVR + CTI) because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Grasshopper
sections.body:
Scenario: for cloud phone teams, recommend Grasshopper when Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number; recommend an alternative path when Teams needing full UCaaS (meetings + team chat + deep IVR + CTI) because Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for cloud phone plus a freeze window if Zapier are in the cutover path.

Final call: proceed with Grasshopper when cloud phone plus cloud phone outweigh Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); walk when Teams needing full UCaaS (meetings + team chat + deep IVR + CTI) because workarounds will eat the True Solo spend.
